next_question.rationale: There remains a large unexplained loss: top_gap lost = 417,569 while reason clusters sum to user_total = 199,417 + artifact_total = 42,107 = 241,524, leaving 176,045 unexplained. Large explicit user reasons exist ('user abandon the cart' = 111,993; 'user clicked back' = 83,517). Consultation-required items convert worse (rx_gated entered = 255,293, converted = 76,641, rate = 0.3002 vs non_rx entered = 391,898, converted = 152,981, rate = 0.3904) but consultation-like pd_category counts are small (e.g., Digital Clinic entered = 3,889; Mental Health entered = 1,075). A distribution-only view of price_band shows meaningful volume in higher bands (75k_200k entered = 90,851; gte_200k entered = 66,220; 25k_75k entered = 62,875; lt_25k entered = 24,769) but does not allocate the unexplained 176,045 loss or the big user reasons across bands. Request the created->confirmed funnel (entered, confirmed, conversion rate) plus abandon_reason counts broken down by price_band so we can (a) allocate portions of the unexplained 176,045 loss across price bands, (b) see whether high-price orders have disproportionately low created->confirmed conversion or concentrate the large user reasons ('user abandon the cart' = 111,993; 'user clicked back' = 83,517), and (c) prioritize experiments (e.g., targeted payment options, discounts, or messaging) for bands with high unexplained loss.
